http_request_firewall_custom.description: Administrator routes accept GET, POST and PUT only
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: http.host eq "api.mac-guard.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/")) and not http.request.method in {"GET" "POST" "PUT"}

http_request_firewall_custom.description: The Stripe webhook is POST only
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: http.host eq "api.mac-guard.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/stripe/webhook")) and not http.request.method in {"POST"}

http_request_firewall_custom.description: /mcp is POST only (the Worker also answers 405)
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: http.host eq "api.mac-guard.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/mcp")) and not http.request.method in {"POST"}

http_request_firewall_custom.description: TRACE, CONNECT and similar are never needed on the API
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: http.host eq "api.mac-guard.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/")) and http.request.method in {"TRACE" "CONNECT" "TRACK"}

http_ratelimit.description: Administrator routes: 20 requests per minute per IP, blocked for 10 minutes (stops key/TOTP guessing)
Stripe webhook: 120 requests per minute per IP (signature verification is the real control)
MCP: 300 requests per minute per IP (per-key quotas apply on top)
Authenticated REST (/v1/ except the public paths): 600 requests per minute per IP
http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "api.mac-guard.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/")) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/community/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/health")
